subject: Storify renewal: proposed monthly commit increase & new rate class
messages:
From: Elena Suarez <elena@storify.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Diego Rojas <diego@storify.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Aug 2026 18:02:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning — committing to higher throughput for H2

Ben,

Hope you’re well. We’ve completed our internal forecast for H2 and expect our usage to increase by ~2.4x compared to the current commit. Leadership is comfortable moving to a larger monthly commit if we can lock in the current rate band for the committed volume and maintain the same burst terms (monthly burst pocket + soft-throttle guardrails).

Can you share an updated commitment worksheet with pricing for:
- 3x current monthly committed tokens
- 2x current monthly committed tokens (as a fallback)
- confirmation of burst pocket size and any changes to rate limits

Procurement is looping in their legal/procurement lead (copied) and would like to align on PO cadence and invoicing (monthly vs quarterly). We’re targeting a renewal signature by Aug 12 to hit provisioning timelines.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 20-min call tomorrow if helpful.

—Elena
Head of Product, Storify AI
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Suarez <elena@storify.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Aug 2026 09:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — committing to higher throughput for H2

Elena — thanks for the note and the clear target. Quick responses to your ask:

1) Pricing/worksheets: attached is a short worksheet with two proposed commit tiers (2x and 3x) plus the burst pocket sizing and the effective per-token rates for each band. Summary: 2x keeps you in the Gold rate class; 3x moves you into our Premium rate class which includes a 7% unit price improvement and a 1.5x burst pocket increase.

2) Burst & rate limits: burst pocket will be sized at 15% of committed tokens for the Gold and 22% for Premium. Soft-throttle threshold remains at 125% sustained for 5 minutes; hard throttle only above 200% sustained for 15 minutes. No change to per-request QPS limits unless you opt into additional dedicated lanes.

3) Invoicing: we can do monthly invoicing against a PO. If procurement prefers quarterly prepay, we can offer a small cashflow discount (1.5%).

Next steps I propose:
- If you’re aligned with the Premium path (3x), sign the attached term summary and we’ll push a DocuSign for the contract amendment + updated SLA.
- Procurement sends PO referencing deal STOR-4821 and we’ll confirm provisioning dates.

I’m available 10–10:30am PT today for a quick call to walk the worksheet.

Attachments: redwood_commit_worksheet_STOR-4821.xlsx

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Procurement <procurement@storify.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Suarez <elena@storify.ai>, Diego Rojas <diego@storify.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Aug 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal planning — committing to higher throughput for H2

Ben — thanks for the worksheet. Storify procurement approvals are good for the Premium band if Redwood confirms the final unit rate and the SLA appendix. Please see attached draft PO (Storify_PO_2026.pdf). A few quick procurement questions:

1) Can Redwood confirm NET30 invoice terms?
2) We require a completed W-9 and Redwood primary contact for billing.
3) Please include the SLA_Appendix and the DocuSign envelope in the return so we can track internally.

If we can get the final contract and invoice cadence by end of day Aug 6, procurement can issue the signed PO on Aug 7.

—Procurement Team
Storify AI

Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround. Responses inline:

1) NET30 is confirmed. We’ll mark invoices with the PO number and send to billing@storify.ai (please confirm that address).
2) W-9 attached. Primary billing contact is Maria Holt (maria_holt@redwood.ai).
3) SLA appendix attached (SLA_Appendix_Redwood_2026.docx). I’m also creating the DocuSign envelope now; once Elena confirms the Premium line we’ll route for signature. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/Envelope123456789

Operational notes on provisioning and throttles:
- Once the signed amendment and PO are in, we’ll schedule the provisioning window within 48 hours.
- We will keep the soft-throttle behavior as discussed and enable an additional burst buffer for the first 30 days to absorb any onramp spikes.

Please confirm the billing address and whether you want monthly invoices or quarterly prepay (note: prepay would require an updated invoice schedule).

Cheers,
Ben
